title: VIXEN lacks a queued target for canonical VoxelDocument header regeneration
body: The VIXEN codegen graph regenerates recipe/appflow/view artifacts but has no supported queued target that writes VIXEN/libraries/SVO/include/Recipe/generated/VoxelDocument.g.h from the pinned kernel emitter. This lane had to build a temporary runner against the canonical SDFNodeGenerator and invoke it through the queue; the first runner build also needed a source-level correction before it could run. Add a checked-in regeneration target and drift check so consumers do not hand-provision this generated boundary.

title: Build queue elastic top-up can terminate admitted VIXEN builds
body: The required queued VIXEN build was first terminated during dependency provisioning after the queue elastic top-up path failed with box-queue-core exit 70 (unexpected argument 'true'). A retry was also terminated by the same top-up failure. Capping the same queued command with --credits 1 avoided elastic growth and completed successfully, at the cost of a serial build. The queue should keep an admitted payload alive when top-up accounting fails or provide a stable non-elastic build route.
